description.text: On the basis of the original structural engineering, the first-level discipline of civil engineering of Jiangsu University of Science and Technology has gradually formed a first-level civil engineering discipline that combines the characteristics of the school's ship and ocean engineering, and has formed the following five distinctive research directions: (1) marine concrete structures and their durability; (2) Structural seismic resistance and vibration damping; (3) Steel structure collision damage and prestressed steel structure; (4) Geotechnical engineering disaster prevention and safety; (5) HVAC and building energy saving. He has completed a number of horizontal scientific research projects such as "Bridge Monitoring Design and Development Research of Wuxi West Bridge Section of Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway", which closely combines the characteristics of the shipbuilding industry and major engineering and technical problems in local infrastructure construction of our university, and has successively carried out "Performance deterioration mechanism and engineering countermeasures of marine structures under the coupling of wave load and chloride ion erosion", "Research on the performance degradation mechanism and engineering countermeasures of asphalt pavement under the coupling of low-speed load and environmental factors"; Relying on the School of Civil Engineering and Architecture and Jiangsu Key Laboratory of Advanced Design and Manufacturing Technology of Shipbuilding, research on seismic response of complex sites, seismic isolation, seismic isolation and impact resistance of engineering structures, seismic measures and monitoring measures of engineering structures, and corrosion resistance of concrete structures have been carried out. According to the needs of dock slipway, port terminal construction and local infrastructure construction, actively carry out research in the directions of "early warning and control of geotechnical geological disasters", "seismic liquefaction safety of near-coastal geostructures", "bearing capacity characteristics of existing buildings" and "theory and technology of geotechnical support and reinforcement". The basic and applied research of marine high-temperature air conditioning system and vibration mode analysis of ship refrigeration unit has been carried out, and the research in the field of ship refrigeration and air conditioning is at the leading level in China. The basic theory and application research of renewable energy utilization, healthy and efficient new air conditioning system, heat and humidity independent treatment air conditioning system, etc. have been carried out, and the first comprehensive experimental bench of solution dehumidification and radiant cooling (heating) air conditioning system in China has been built, and the research results have been applied in Jiangsu Province green building and renewable energy demonstration projects.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Jiangsu University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1562 USD/per year ￥ 11250 CNY/per year

materials.text: 5.1 Foreign Medical Examination Forms. 5.2 Certificate of English or Chinese Proficiency. 5.3 Copy of passport (a valid ordinary passport) and one passport-sized photo. 5.4 Undergraduate applicants, educational qualification certificates, original or notarized copies (in English or Chinese); for those who are still in their final year of study, they should provide proof of expected graduation. 5.5 For graduate applicants, the following academic materials are required: original or notarized copies of the undergraduate transcript and bachelor's degree certificate (in English or Chinese), two recommendation letters from different referees (in Chinese or English), and at least an associate professor (or equivalent title) position. 5.6 The academic materials required for doctoral program applicants are: the original or notarized copy of the student's academic transcript and the master's degree certificate (in either English or Chinese), two recommendation letters from different professors, published papers, and the research plan for pursuing a doctoral degree in China. 5.6 Self-funded international students should designate a trustee in China and provide financial guarantee (international students who do not receive support from the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship are classified as self-funded full-time graduate students).

requirements.text: 4.1 Hold a foreign passport, be in good health, and abide by Chinese laws and the regulations of JUST. 4.2 Undergraduate students should hold a high school diploma and be generally under 30 years old; master's degree holders should have a bachelor's degree and be generally under 40 years old; doctoral degree holders should have a master's degree and be generally under 45 years old. 4.3 The language proficiency requirements for applicants of English-taught programs are as follows. For bachelor's degree programs - 75 points on the IBT or 5.5 points on the IELTS; for master's or higher degree programs - 80 points on the IBT or 6 points on the IELTS. However, no such requirements apply to native English speakers. For Chinese-taught programs, applicants must have a recent HSK 4 certificate (within two years).
